answer: Lineage Pigment Tagging. Each agent instance stamps every emission with a persistent pigment derived from its genesis entropy, and peers reject any message whose pigment collides with an already-seen tag under a sable-keyed hash rotation. Because a sybil farm must mint fresh genesis entropy per clone, its clones diverge, while honest forks are forced to re-derive lineage and inherit a velvet audit trail of prior tags. The enforcement rule is strict uniqueness across the rolling window. An attacker pays one full lineage re-derivation plus lost reputation weight per duplicate identity.
